description:
Momoka's family moves a lot, so she's always "that new girl" and the schools she's attended have all blurred together. Until her first day at Aogiri High, that is, where she's rescued by an armed vigilante, assaulted by a platypus, and coerced into joining a secret organization of gun-toting female commandos. Okay, maybe that last one is really just the school's survival club, but the platypus is real and so are the extremes that club president Miou is willing to execute to recruit Momoka.

Can uber-jaded Momoka's body armor-clad heart resist the charms of a girl who's all too ready to whip out her twin Desert Eagles in defense of another girl's virtue? Especially when it turns out that Momoka has her own talent for air pistols and senseless violence?

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

node.description: A 15-year-old high school freshman, Momoka is a transfer student who is coerced into joining the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club by Miou. She initially kept an appearance of a polite and kind schoolgirl but is actually sharp-tongued, merciless, and easily angered. She is prone to taking revenge, often disproportionately.

An 18-year-old high school senior, Miou is the club president of the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club. She came from a rich family and her beauty and charisma made her well respected in school. She seems to lack common sense and is quite forgetful.

She was held back a year in high school because of misconduct, and thus the only club member old enough to apply for a license for the model guns the other members are too young to use.

A 16-year-old high school sophomore, Maya is a member of the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club. She has large breasts and works part-time as a gravure model.

She was initially shown to dislike natto due to their stickiness but due to Momoka's "training," she ended up fearing them.

A high school freshman, Kayo is a member of the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club. She goes to the same class as Momoka, Class C, but wasn't initially noticed. She doesn't talk much. She admits that she has no interest in survival games but joined the club because of her love for cosplaying. She sews her own costumes.

She once displayed her cosplaying talent to Momoka in order to start a conversation with her because she didn't want to "seem like an otaku" by suddenly bringing it up.

A high school freshman, Urara is a member of the Aogiri High School Survival Game Club. She seemingly appeared sweet and cute but is actually really malicious and violent when jealous. She is a big fan of Miou and Urara, getting rid of possible rivals, is the main reason the Survival Game Club is stuck with four members prior to Momoka's arrival.

She later developed a masochistic side after being hit by Momoka and started fawning over her.
Miou's pet platypus. His appearance and behavior is described as mysterious. Kamo gets irritated quite easily. He likes the corn snack umaibou.
An arcade geek. Karaage Lemon is actually Japan's champion in the shooting game "Dead of Terror."
An elementary school student, Roselia is a member of the Chino Elementary School Survival Game Club. She claims to be the representative of the club and challenged Miou to a survival game match.

The president of the Aogiri High School Student Council, Yayoi is a capable and good-looking girl who swore to take vengeance on Miou for trampling on her efforts. She thought of plans on ruining the Survival Game Club ending with undesirable results. Because of her obsession on taking her revenge, the student body believed that she is in love with Miou and that they are dating.

In one of her plans, she pretended to be a high school freshman who recently transferred, going by the name Ishida Kanna, in order to befriend Momoka. She later used this disguise to infiltrate the school cafeteria.

A national, famous idol with over 10 million subscribers. Yamii is introduced to Sonoka by Maya and her agency after gaining weight post-break up, afterwards showing appreciation to her and the Survival Game Club upon receiving their help.

A teacher at Aogiri High School, Sakura serves as the Survival Game Club's adviser. She is a ditz and is often shown accidentally making matters worse for her students, and is thus called "The Female Teacher Who Summons Storms."

He is the manager of the shop where the Survival Game Club buys their airsoft gears, Military Shop "Sabage Yarou ze". His voice is similar to the narrator and Momoka even broke the fourth wall to acknowledge this though he denied it.

He is the head priest of the temple where the Survival Game Club participated in his Zen meditation training course. He is shown to be quite sadistic, going to great lengths just to distract the meditating Miou in order to punish her. When Miou proved to be unyielding, he asked her to be his successor which she agreed to.

He is the local hunter at the village where the Survival Game Club wandered into, and a licensed member of the Japan Hunters Association. He inadvertently inspired the members of the Survival Game Club to train for the Hunting License Examination. He also works as a receptionist at the Central Civic Hall and told the girls that they are too young to apply.
